title: 10-Day Ultimate Zanzibar Experience
bestTimeToGo: June to October for dry season; also excellent December to February
highlights: Stone Town city tour with shopping and cultural immersion
Prison Island giant tortoises and Nakupenda sandbank lunch
Le Saint Tropez Beach Club experience
Swim with wild dolphins and snorkel at Mnemba Beach
Swim with sea turtles at Sallaam Cave
Visit the stunning Mtende Beach on the south coast
Dine at the iconic Rock Restaurant
Sunset and beach party at Kae Funk beach
Full-day Safari Blue dhow cruise with seafood lunch
includes: All entrance fees and activity costs
Boat transfers for all water activities

itinerary.dayBody: Welcome to Zanzibar! Our team picks you up from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport and transfers you to your hotel. Settle in and enjoy your first evening on the Spice Island at your own pace.

itinerary.dayTitle: Day 2 — Stone Town, Prison Island & Nakupenda
itinerary.dayBody: Start with a morning walking tour of historic Stone Town — explore the winding alleyways, visit the Old Fort, admire the famous carved doors, and browse local shops. After lunch, board a boat to Prison Island to meet the giant Aldabra tortoises. Then cruise to Nakupenda sandbank for a seafood lunch on a pristine strip of sand surrounded by turquoise water.

itinerary.dayTitle: Day 3 — Le Saint Tropez Beach Club
itinerary.dayBody: A day of pure relaxation at Le Saint Tropez Beach Club. Enjoy world-class beach facilities, swimming pools, cocktails, and a beautiful stretch of white-sand beach. This is your chance to unwind and soak in the island atmosphere.

An early morning start to catch the dolphins at their most active. Head to Mnemba Beach where you’ll board a boat and swim alongside wild bottlenose dolphins in the open ocean. Afterwards, snorkel the incredible coral reefs surrounding Mnemba Atoll, home to sea turtles, tropical fish, and vibrant coral gardens.

itinerary.dayTitle: Day 5 — South Coast: Sea Turtles & Mtende Beach
itinerary.dayBody: Explore Zanzibar’s wild south coast. Visit Sallaam Cave to swim with sea turtles in a crystal-clear natural pool. Then head to Mtende Beach — one of the most beautiful and secluded beaches on the island, with powder-white sand and turquoise waters stretching as far as the eye can see.

A free day to rest and recharge. Relax at your hotel, explore the local area on your own, visit the beach, or book a spa treatment. Your guide is available if you need recommendations or want to arrange anything spontaneous.
Another day at your own pace. Perfect for sleeping in, catching up on reading, or simply enjoying the rhythm of island life. Optional activities can be arranged on request.

itinerary.dayTitle: Day 8 — The Rock Restaurant, Kae Funk & Shanga
itinerary.dayBody: Visit Shanga Restaurant for a unique dining experience that supports local artisans with disabilities. Later, head south to the iconic Rock Restaurant, perched on a rock in the Indian Ocean — one of the most photographed restaurants in Africa. End the day at Kae Funk beach for sunset drinks and a legendary beach party.

The grand finale: a full-day Safari Blue dhow cruise. Sail on a traditional wooden dhow through the turquoise waters of Menai Bay. Visit sandbanks, snorkel over coral reefs, swim in the sheltered lagoon, and feast on a freshly prepared seafood lunch on a secluded island. This is Zanzibar’s most iconic ocean excursion.
Your Zanzibar adventure comes to an end. We pick you up from your hotel and transfer you to the airport in time for your flight. Goodbye and we hope to see you again — Kwaheri!

whatToBring: Modest clothing for Stone Town and village visits
pickupInfo: Airport pickup and drop-off included. Daily hotel pickup for all activities.
cancellationPolicyShort: Free cancellation up to 7 days before the start date.

seo.title: 10-Day Ultimate Zanzibar Experience | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: The complete Zanzibar experience over 10 days: Stone Town, Prison Island, dolphins, Safari Blue, The Rock Restaurant, south coast beaches, and more. All transfers included.

content:
This is the ultimate Zanzibar package — 10 days of carefully curated experiences that take you from the historic alleyways of Stone Town to the untouched beaches of the south coast, from swimming with dolphins at dawn to watching the sunset with a cocktail at a legendary beach club.

Every day brings a new adventure: one day you’re feeding century-old tortoises on Prison Island and lunching on a disappearing sandbank; the next you’re diving into a crystal-clear cave to swim alongside sea turtles. You’ll dine at The Rock Restaurant — literally perched on a rock in the Indian Ocean — party at the famous Kae Funk beach, and sail on a traditional dhow through the impossibly blue waters of Menai Bay.

But it’s not all go-go-go. We’ve built in rest days because Zanzibar is also about slowing down, feeling the warm breeze, and letting the island work its magic. This package is designed for travellers who want to see and do it all, but at island pace.
